transcript: There are four people you must forgive if you are truly serious about changing your life and learning how to live in the present. The first are your parents, whether they are still alive or not. Forgive them for every mistake they made while raising you. Not because they were perfect, but because they were human. The second are those from past marriages or relationships that did not work out. Release what was. It has already taught you what it came to teach. The third are all others who have ever hurt you in any way. Holding on does not protect you. It only keeps you tied to the past. Gently clean the slate. When their name appears in your mind, say quietly, I forgive you for everything, and I wish you well. And the fourth, the most important one, is yourself. Forgive yourself for every foolish, careless, unkind or unconscious thing you have ever done or said. Stop carrying these moments with you. They belong to another time. That was then. This is now. And if you feel ready to walk this path more deeply, with daily practices that help you release, soften and return to the present, the 30-day healing journey is available in the link on my profile. You do not need to rush, but you do need to begin.
